title: kithctl status: own identity and tailnet info
description:
Implement kithctl status: call Tailscale LocalAPI status() and print the local node's own identity and tailnet IPs.

WHAT: Let the operator verify their tailnet identity and confirm tailscaled is reachable.

ALGORITHM:
1. Build Config from env + CLI overrides
2. Create LocalApiClient::new(&config.ts_socket)
3. Call client.status().await — on Err: eprintln!("error: tailscaled not reachable: {e}") and std::process::exit(1)
4. On Ok(resp): print formatted lines:
   - println!("Backend State: {}", resp.backend_state)
   - println!("User ID:       {}", resp.self_node.user_id)
   - println!("Tailnet IPs:")
   - for ip in &resp.tailscale_ips { println!("  {ip}") }
5. Return Ok(())

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- Never log user_id as a secret — it is an opaque identifier, not a credential; printing is fine
- Timeout is already enforced inside LocalApiClient (5s) — do not add a second timeout
- If tailscale_ips is empty, print "  (none)" not a panic or silent skip
- backend_state may be any string; do not match on it, just display

TESTS: No unit test possible without live tailscaled. Document: run manually with tailscaled present to verify. Integration test deferred to E2E bead.
